main.description: Stream every archived and live Jetstream event in seq order, framed per the xrpc.v1.json subprotocol. The kinds, dids, and collections filters are independent predicates ANDed together; each is match-all when omitted. See the parameter and error descriptions for cursor, filtering, and compression semantics.

contract.description: Optional wire contract selector. Omit for ordinary Jetstream v2 behavior. hypercerts-selected-v1 enables durable selected-stream metadata; streamId and cursor are then required together or omitted together. Unsupported values fail pre-upgrade with UnsupportedContract.

streamId.description: Required with cursor when contract=hypercerts-selected-v1; identifies the selected stream.

cursor.description: For clients resuming this stream, the position is inclusive: the server replays events with seq >= cursor and the client dedups the overlap. Ordinary v2 (contract omitted): values >= 1e15 are interpreted as a unix-microseconds timestamp instead of a seq and translated to the first seq witnessed at or after that instant; a timestamp below the retention floor clamps up to the floor and an #info OutdatedCursor frame is sent. A seq below the retention floor is rejected before WebSocket upgrade with HTTP 400 (CursorTooOld). With contract=hypercerts-selected-v1, cursor is strictly an unsigned decimal uint64 seq with no timestamp heuristics or clamping, and streamId and cursor must be supplied together and non-empty or both omitted. Selected resumes are rejected before WebSocket upgrade with HTTP 400: InvalidCursor for malformed or unpaired coordinates, StreamMismatch for a different streamId, CursorOutOfRange for a seq beyond the current tip, or ReplayUnavailable when replay is disabled or the seq is below replayFloor. Omitted (with streamId also omitted for selected subscriptions): start at the live tip.

kinds.description: Event kinds to receive; values are the message $type fragment names. Omitted or empty: all kinds. A value outside the enum is rejected pre-upgrade with HTTP 400 (InvalidRequest) rather than silently never matching.

dids.description: Repo DIDs to receive events for; applies to every event kind. Omitted or empty: all repos.

collections.description: Collection NSIDs or '<prefix>.*' patterns; constrains which commit events are delivered. Non-commit kinds are unaffected — combine with kinds=commit for a commits-only collection stream. Rejected pre-upgrade with HTTP 400 (InvalidRequest) when kinds is set and excludes commit, since the filter could never apply. Omitted or empty: all collections.

maxMessageSizeBytes.description: Skip events whose uncompressed frame (envelope included) exceeds this many bytes. 0 (default) means no limit.

zstdDictionary.description: Jetstream extension: opt into dict-zstd frame compression with the given zstd dictionary ID (obtained via network.bsky.jetstream.getZstdDictionary). Frames then arrive as binary websocket messages, each one zstd frame whose decompressed bytes are exactly the xrpc.v1.json text frame. An unknown or retired ID is rejected pre-upgrade with HTTP 400 carrying the current ID.

errors.name: ConsumerTooSlow
errors.description: The client is far behind the live tip AND reading below the server's floor rate for a sustained window; the server drops adversarially-slow readers. A merely-slow-but-progressing reader is never dropped.

errors.name: CursorTooOld
errors.description: Rejected pre-upgrade with HTTP 400, never as a stream error frame: the requested seq cursor is below the server's retention floor. The message carries the floor seq; archive-backfilling clients re-enter backfill from their last durable seq.

errors.name: UnknownZstdDictionary
errors.description: Rejected pre-upgrade with HTTP 400, never as a stream error frame: the zstdDictionary ID is unknown or retired. The message carries the current dictionary ID; re-fetch via network.bsky.jetstream.getZstdDictionary.

commit.description: A single record mutation (create, update, or delete).

seq.description: Jetstream's monotonic per-event sequence number; the stream cursor.

time.description: The event's display timestamp, microsecond precision: when Jetstream witnessed the event, unless an operator timestamp import overrode it. Timestamp cursors translate against the witnessed time, so after an import this value may not be a faithful resume position.

rev.description: The repo rev of the commit that produced this op.

record.description: The record decoded to JSON. Absent for deletes.

cid.description: CID of the record. Absent for deletes.

identity.description: An identity change (handle or DID document update), wrapping the upstream firehose event verbatim.

time.description: The time Jetstream witnessed this event, microsecond precision. Timestamp imports apply only to record (commit) events, so this is always the witnessed time.

identity.description: The upstream event; its seq and time are the upstream relay's, not Jetstream's.

account.description: An account status change (active/deactivated/deleted/...), wrapping the upstream firehose event verbatim.

time.description: The time Jetstream witnessed this event, microsecond precision. Timestamp imports apply only to record (commit) events, so this is always the witnessed time.

account.description: The upstream event; its seq and time are the upstream relay's, not Jetstream's.

selectedMetadata.description: Optional Hypercerts metadata present only when contract=hypercerts-selected-v1 is negotiated. Ordinary v2 frames omit it.

collections.description: Collection NSID array or null. Preserved as raw JSON so empty arrays and null survive typed-client round trips.
Collection NSID array or null. Preserved as raw JSON so empty arrays and null survive typed-client round trips.

effectiveAfterSeq.description: Sequence integer or explicit null; absent when this notice does not advertise this boundary. Raw JSON preserves all three states.

replayFloor.description: Sequence integer or explicit null; absent when this notice does not advertise this boundary. Raw JSON preserves all three states.

originalHistoryFromSeq.description: Sequence integer or explicit null; absent when this notice does not advertise this boundary. Raw JSON preserves all three states.

gaps.description: Array of selectedGap objects, including an empty array; absent on notices other than SelectedFeed. Raw JSON preserves presence without adding capability fields to PolicyAdopted.

sync.description: An archived #sync event (broken commit chain; consumers should resync the repo). Ordinary v2 subscriptions receive the upstream event; selected-contract subscriptions receive lifecycle metadata without CAR blocks or unselected operation payloads. Never emitted on the legacy v1 /subscribe wire.

time.description: The time Jetstream witnessed this event, microsecond precision. Timestamp imports apply only to record (commit) events, so this is always the witnessed time.

sync.description: The upstream event; its seq and time are the upstream relay's, not Jetstream's.

info.description: An advisory, non-fatal notice about the stream (mirrors com.atproto.sync.subscribeRepos#info). Carries no seq and does not advance the cursor. Selected subscriptions may send SelectedFeed first, then PolicyAdopted or Reconciliation notices with selected metadata. OutdatedCursor is sent for ordinary v2 timestamp resumes below the retention floor.
